article_notes: 342 PCR/sequencing-confirmed B. canis dogs from samples submitted to a commercial laboratory in Germany (2018-2024); clinical and outcome data by questionnaire to primary-care veterinarians; outcome known for 193 dogs (169 uncomplicated, 24 complicated, 13 died). Cohort overlap: the same 342 dogs were analysed in an earlier paper by the same group (parasitaemia, acute phase response, serostatus). Descriptive statistics only (Wilson CIs); no tests between outcome groups. The only factor reported against outcome is history of stays abroad (no stays abroad / travelled / imported), given as outcome per exposure group; extracted as descriptive_only. Complicated course is not defined.

severity_definitions.label: died vs survived
severity_definitions.definition: Death or euthanasia as reported by the treating veterinarian, in dogs with outcome information (n=193). Follow-up horizon not stated.
severity_definitions.quote: Complicated courses were described for 12.4% of dogs in the present study, including a mortality rate of 6.7%.

severity_definitions.label: complicated vs uncomplicated course
severity_definitions.definition: Complicated or uncomplicated course as reported by the treating veterinarian; complications not defined or listed.
severity_definitions.quote: Uncomplicated courses were reported in 169 of 193 dogs (87.6%, 95% CI: 82.2–91.5%), complicated courses in 24 of 193 dogs (12.4%, 95% CI: 8.5–17.8%).

associations.marker_as_reported: history of stays abroad (no stays abroad / travelled / imported)
associations.statistic: mortality: no stays abroad 7 of 101 (6.9%, 95% CI 3.4-13.6%); travelled 3 of 20 (15.0%); imported: none of 40 died (100% survival)
associations.quote: Of the 20 dogs that had travelled, 3 died (mortality rate: 15.0%). Of the 40 imported dogs with available information on the outcome, all had uncomplicated courses and a 100% survival rate.
associations.note: Outcome given per history group, not marker per outcome group, so severe_value and comparison_value are null. Imported dogs: no deaths; travelled dogs: highest mortality; no test. Mortality for dogs without stays abroad is in the preceding sentence (7 dogs died or were euthanised, 6.9%). Group sizes with outcome data: 101 without stays abroad, 20 travelled, 40 imported.

associations.marker_as_reported: history of stays abroad (no stays abroad / travelled / imported)
associations.statistic: no stays abroad: complicated course with survival 7 of 101 (6.9%) plus complicated course with death or euthanasia 7; imported: all 40 uncomplicated
associations.quote: In this group, complicated course with survival was described for 7 dogs (6.9%, 95% CI: 3.4–13.6%), and complicated courses with subsequent death or euthanasia were reported for another 7 dogs, resulting in a mortality rate of 6.9% (95% CI: 3.4–13.6%).
associations.note: Imported dogs (n=40) all had uncomplicated courses; complicated course counts for travelled dogs not given. No test; direction mixed (imported dogs less often complicated).
